## Appearance

Gilbert Blythe is a tall boy distinguished by his curly brown hair. He also features roguish hazel eyes.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)_

## Personality

Gilbert Blythe is a clever, ambitious, and good-natured young man who frequently displays a kind, thoughtful, and teasing demeanor. He is determined to get the most out of life while putting his best into it, and he faces the necessity of earning his own way through college. Among his peers, he is known for his skill at recitation.

## History

Upon returning to school, Gilbert Blythe attempted to get [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's attention by pulling her hair and calling her a nickname, prompting her to smash a slate over his head and refuse his apology. Although [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) held a long-standing grudge and engaged in an intense academic rivalry with him, Gilbert rescued her from a sinking boat, only for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to coldly reject his attempt to make peace. Her rivalry with him continued through their time at school and Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), where Gilbert won the medal while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) won the Avery scholarship. After graduation, Gilbert gave up his teaching post in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) could take it and stay close to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), leading the two to finally reconcile and become close friends.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

Gilbert and Anne's relationship begins with a deep, one-sided grudge after Gilbert pulls her hair and calls her 'Carrots' during class, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to smash a slate over his head and reject his apology. Despite his repeated attempts to make peace—including saving her from a sinking boat—[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) coldly refuses his friendship for a long time. Over time, their mutual academic rivalry for top marks drives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to study intensely, even as she secretly regrets holding her grudge, and seeing him in an audience eventually inspires her to overcome stage fright and perform successfully.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), +27 more_

### [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--shirley.md)

Gilbert and [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) engage in an intense academic competition at school, pushing each other to excel in their studies. By the end of their time at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), their rivalry culminates at commencement, where [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) wins the Avery scholarship while Gilbert captures the medal.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P14](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), +5 more_
